located_observations.location: upper third, lever and left entering hand
located_observations.observation: A large white hand with black contours wraps the underside of a black lever, its thumb above and four curled fingers below. The pivot and same door edge are visible.
The broad white worn area has broken jagged speckles and chipped-looking boundaries; fine gray grain continues across the black handle. This is rougher than the assigned smooth flat contact patch.
The key blade reaches the lock face and the thumb/index grasp its black bow. The opening is a large rounded-head/neck traditional keyhole outline, leaving blade-to-cylinder keyway fit uncertain.

located_observations.location: lower lock face and below it
located_observations.observation: Gray ring shading and a vertically streaked gray drop/shadow below the lock add texture and modeled depth instead of the assigned pure black/white flat finish.

located_observations.location: central-left copy and lower practical information
located_observations.observation: All seven entries are readable at 720px width; hours wrap after the slash, and URL remains on one intact line. The date/place group sits adjacent to the large lower lock.
